messages.greetingReply: Hello! I am HelpDesk AI. I can assist with IT issues such as login and account access, password resets, email and Outlook problems, network and VPN connectivity, hardware troubleshooting, software errors, printer issues, and security concerns. What can I help you with today?
messages.outOfScopeMessage: This system only supports IT helpdesk topics. Please ask about account access, hardware, network, software, email, security, or system troubleshooting.
messages.mixedScopeMessage: Your message appears to contain topics outside the scope of IT helpdesk support. Please focus your question on IT-related issues.
messages.followUpNoContextMessage: It looks like you're starting a new conversation. Please describe your IT support issue so I can assist you.
messages.emptyPromptMessage: Please enter your IT support question.
messages.promptTooLongMessage: Your prompt is too long. Please shorten it to continue.
messages.defaultOutOfScopeMessage: I can only assist with IT support topics such as account access, hardware issues, network problems, software errors, email, security, or server troubleshooting. Please rephrase your question.
messages.clarifyMessage: Could you clarify if this is an IT-related issue? I'm here to help with IT support topics.
